stages.title: Stage 1 — Narootuh starter batch
stages.where: Stay in Narootuh the whole stage — grouped by activity, not by quest number.
stages.combo: 5 batches: accept everything (0) → kill everything (1) → turn-ins in Narootuh (2) → Cargo trip (3) → final turn-ins (4). The 3 Guard quests aren’t on the server’s quest list — found in-game, marked with gold pins.

quests.name: Step 0 — Accept everything first
quests.reward: No rewards yet — just clears the accept step for all 7 quests so you don’t have to backtrack for it later

quests.name: Step 1 — Kill everything

steps.text: Kill Lower Class Demons for everything below (around Narootuh — covers Quest 1, Quest 3, Event Quest 1, and all 3 Guard quests in one grind)

quests.reward: No turn-ins yet — carry all 6 drops into Step 2

quests.name: Step 2 — Talk to people in Narootuh again

steps.label: Report — Quest 3 (not done yet, needs a Cargo trip)

quests.reward: 100 XP (Event Quest 1) + G5 Weapon + G8 Chest + G8 Gloves/Boots/Shorts/Helmet + 80 XP, 3 Small Medicines (Quest 1)

quests.name: Step 3 — Cargo trip
quests.reward: No reward yet — clears the way for Step 4’s turn-ins

quests.name: Step 4 — Back to Narootuh to finish up
quests.reward: 100 geons, 2 Small Medicines (Quest 2) + 73 XP, 200 geons, 1 Contribution Point (Quest 3)

stages.title: Stage 2 — Demon Escort Archers
stages.where: Narootuh only.
stages.combo: Event Quest 3 (Lv 1, Sae-Ryu) is woven into Quest 4 — same mobs drop its Escort Soldier’s Head too, and you report to Sae-Ryu twice along the way. Only Cargo/Geum-Oh Mine are left for it in Stage 4.

quests.name: Bonus Quest — Goby Fishing (optional, highly recommended)

steps.text: Fish 1x Goby

quests.note: You’ll have ~300 geons from the earlier quests by now — the Fish Hook is only 40, and fishing takes ~15 seconds with a guaranteed Goby, so this is basically a free G9 weapon.

steps.text: Kill Demon Escort Archer/Soldier for 10x "Demon’s Bow" and 30x "Escort Soldier’s Head" (the head is for Event Quest 3, turned in later in Stage 4)

stages.title: Stage 3 — Suicide Bombers
stages.where: Cargo → Geum-Oh Mine → Cargo.

steps.text: Kill Suicide Bombers for 10x "Suicide Bomber’s Oil"

stages.title: Stage 4 — Demon Carcass Scavenger combo
stages.where: Narootuh ↔ Cargo, weaving between Ha-Jik/Boatman/Sae-Ryu and Nu-Woong/In-Pill.
stages.combo: Quest 6 + Event Quest 3 combined — same camp, same two mobs, just two turn-in NPCs (Ha-Jik, In-Pill). Keep killing Demon Carcass Scavengers a bit longer: Quest 8 (Stage 5) wants 25x Demon’s Carcass from the same mob.

steps.text: Kill Big Handed Inhabitants for 15x tooth and 1x "Big Handed Inhabitant’s Head"
Kill Demon Carcass Scavengers for 2x "Straw Rice" and "In-Pills Scabbard"

stages.title: Stage 5 — Milk Wetch / White Peony loop + Carcass follow-up
stages.where: Cargo ↔ Narootuh.

steps.text: Kill Big Handed Slaves — collect 22 Milk Wetch + 22 White Peony (10+10 now, 12+12 extra for Quest 9)
Kill Demon Carcass Scavengers for 25x "Demon’s Carcass" (same camp as Stage 4)

steps.label: Hand in stockpiled Milk Wetch/White Peony

stages.title: Stage 6 — Demon Soldier’s Teeth
stages.where: Geum-Oh Mine ↔ Cargo.

steps.text: Kill Demon Soldiers for 20x "Demon Soldier’s Teeth"

stages.title: Stage 7 — Egg quest
stages.where: Narootuh → Cargo → Narootuh.

steps.text: Kill Naughty Doggebi (Cargo) for "Keg of Talisman"

stages.title: Stage 8 — Big Handed Warriors combo
stages.where: Geum-Oh Mine ↔ Narootuh ↔ Cargo.
stages.combo: Accept Event Quest 5 first (Geum-Oh Mine). Farm Blue + Red Warriors together — Blue drops Quest 11 + Event Quest 5, Red drops Quest 12 — then turn in all three.

steps.text: Kill Big Handed Blue Warriors for 25x "Rice Cake" (grab Red Warrior/Head drops too)
Kill Big Handed Red Warrior for "Wa-Ryu’s Talisman"

stages.title: Stage 9 — Joo-Nong’s Gold
stages.where: Narootuh ↔ Geum-Oh Mine.

steps.text: Kill Demon Infantry for 30x "Joo-Nong’s Gold"

stages.title: Stage 10 — Bamboo Poles
stages.where: Geum-Oh Mine ↔ Cargo.

steps.text: Kill Demon Throwing Soldiers for 30x "Piece of Bamboo Pole"

stages.title: Stage 11 — Wild Demon Soldiers
stages.where: Geum-Oh Mine.

steps.text: Kill Wild Demon Soldiers for 30x "Statue"

stages.title: Stage 12 — Demon Shock Troopers
stages.where: Cargo ↔ Geum-Oh Mine.

steps.text: Kill Demon Shock Troopers for 30x "Ja-Gan’s Gold"

stages.title: Stage 13 — General Sae-Won’s chain
stages.where: Cargo only — same NPC, three separate visits as you level up.

steps.text: Kill Demon Flag Bearers for 35x "Red Flag"
Kill Demon Water Dragons for 35x "Demon Water Dragon Head"
Kill Demon Band for 40x "Demon’s Drum"

stages.title: Stage 14 — Cargo solo run
stages.where: Cargo Station only — same routine, four times in a row.

steps.text: Kill Demon Armored Knight for 40x "Demon’s Armor"
Kill Hungry Demon Water Dragon for 40x "Bloodstained Clothes"
Kill Demon Water Dragon Predator for 40x "Demon Water Dragon Skin"
Kill Demon Mad Knight for 40x "Demon Mad Knight Head"

stages.title: Stage 15 — Job Change #1 + Trinket’s Quest
stages.where: Geum-Oh Mine, then the Fort — this is a big milestone stage.
stages.combo: Event Quest 8 = 1st Job Change, do it at 30. You only need 1x Demon Commander’s Head — Quest 27 (Stage 16) needs a different drop from the same mob, so no need to stock up.

steps.text: Find "Moon-Hee’s Doll" from Castoff Baby Ghost
Try to get "Demon Commander’s Head" from Demon Commander first, to save a trip
Find "Demon Commander’s Head" if you don’t have it yet
Kill Ghosts for 100x "Sealed Talisman with Spirits"
Kill different devil soldiers for their head

items.name: 1x Devil Soldier with Twin Blades Head

stages.title: Stage 16 — Ghost beads at the Fort
stages.where: Temporary Fort of Geum-Ohee Castle, one side-trip to Geum-Oh Mine.

steps.text: Kill Ghost Of Young Man for "Wolf Tooth Necklace"
Kill Ghost Of Young Woman for 10x "Ghost Bead"
Kill Demon Commander for "Demon Troops Confidential Document" (same mob as Event Quest 8)
Kill Ghost Of Blacksmith for 10x "Blacksmith Bead"

stages.title: Stage 17 — More Fort ghost beads
stages.where: Fort, one side-trip to Geum-Oh Mine.

steps.text: Kill Ghost Guard for 10x "Ghost Guard Bead"
Kill Demon Dragon Commander for "Demon Water Dragon Commanders Skin"

stages.title: Stage 18 — Fellow Traveller / Sealed Troop
stages.where: Fort only.

steps.text: Kill Fellow traveller to the other world for 10x "Fellow Traveller Bead"

mobs.name: Fellow traveller to the other world

steps.text: Kill Sealed ghost troop for 10x "Sealed Troop Bead"
Kill Devil Soldier With Bow for 10x "Devil Soldier’s Bow"

stages.title: Stage 19 — Devil Soldier’s Spear
stages.where: Fort only.

steps.text: Kill Devil Soldier’s Spear for 10x "Devil Soldier’s Spear"

quests.name: Event Quest 14 — Devil Troops of Absorbing Green

steps.text: Kill Devil Troop Of Absorbing for "Green Crystal"

quests.note: Devil Troop Of Absorbing Green spawns on the way to D3, and around the D1 gates.

stages.title: Stage 20 — To-Woo’s errand + Ghost Hunter masks
stages.where: Fort, with a trip out of town.

steps.text: Kill Devil Troop Of Pain for 100x "Devil Troop of Pain’s Mask"

stages.title: Stage 21 — Red Flag Leader’s errand + Ghost Hunter masks
stages.where: Fort → Narootuh → Geum-Oh Mine → Fort, then out of town.

steps.text: Kill Devil Troop Of Greed for 100x "Devil Troop of Greed’s Mask"

stages.title: Stage 22 — Seoung-Gill’s secret + Ghost Hunter masks
stages.where: Fort, with trips out of town.

steps.text: Kill Devil Troop Of Jealousy for 100x "Devil Troop of Jealousy’s Mask"

stages.title: Stage 23 — Hatred combo + Doggebi spirits
stages.where: Out of town + Fort + Forsaken Fort.
stages.combo: Quest 41 + 42 both farm Devil Troop Of Hatred — one grind covers both.

steps.text: Kill Devil Troop Of Hatred for "Rope"
Kill Devil Troop Of Hatred for 100x "Devil Troop of Hatred’s Mask" (same mob as Quest 41)
Kill different Doggebis for their Spirit

items.name: 1x Spirit of Doggebi of Monster Face
1x Spirit of Doggebi with a Gong
1x Spirit of Doggebi with a Mask of Black Crow
1x Spirit of Doggebi with a Mask of Black Panther

Doggebi with Mask of Black Panther

steps.label: Kill Chief of Angry Doggebi Troop for its dead body

items.name: 1x Chief of Angry Doggebi Troop’s Dead Body

stages.title: Stage 24 — Doll for a Doggebi friend + last mask
stages.where: Out of town + Fort.

steps.text: Kill Devil Troop Of Anger for "Defective Doggebi’s Doll"
Kill Devil Troop Of Madness for 100x "Devil Troop of Madness’ Mask"

stages.title: Stage 25 — Doggebi broom collection
stages.where: Out of town only, four NPCs in a row.
stages.combo: Quests 45-49 all need 5 Blood of Big Handed too — stockpile it once, covers the whole chain.

steps.text: Kill Doggebi Of Monster Face for its broom + 5x Blood of Big Handed
Kill Doggebi with Gong for its broom + 5x Blood of Big Handed
Kill Drunken Doggebi for its broom + 5x Blood of Big Handed
Kill Doggebi with Mask of Black Crow for its broom + 5x Blood of Big Handed

items.name: 1x Doggebi with Mask of Black Crow’s Broom

mobs.name: Doggebi with Mask of Black Crow

stages.title: Stage 26 — Lv 50: 2nd Job Change
stages.where: Out of town, then the Fort — big milestone stage.
stages.combo: Event Quest 20 = 2nd Job Change, do it at 50 — last event quest on this server. From here it’s normal quests only, through Quest 62 (Lv 60).

steps.text: Find "Doggebi with Mask of Black Panther’s Broom" and 5x "Blood of Big Handed" from Doggebi with Mask of Black Panther

items.name: 1x Doggebi with Mask of Black Panther’s Broom

mobs.name: Doggebi with Mask of Black Panther

steps.text: Pick your job — this choice is permanent, confirm twice

stages.title: Stage 27 — Lv 51: One-armed Man errand
stages.where: Out of town (Cargo / Geum-Oh Mine area).

steps.text: Find "Giant Doggebi’s Broom" and 5x "Blood of Big Handed" from Giant Doggebis

stages.title: Stage 28 — Lv 52-53: Manager’s errand + first Pub visit
stages.where: Out of town, then Fort → Pub of the Giant Bird.

steps.text: Find "Guardian of Doggebi’s Stone" and 5x "Water Dragon Blood" from Guardian of Doggebi
Find 5x "Skeleton Warrior’s Head" from Rotten Skeleton Warrior of the Royal Tomb

mobs.name: Rotten Skeleton Warrior of the Royal Tomb (Sword)

stages.title: Stage 29 — Lv 54-57: Tomb Keeper grind chain begins
stages.where: Pub of the Giant Bird — this NPC carries you for a while.

steps.text: Find 5x "Skeleton Warrior’s Ribs" from Rotten Skeleton Warrior of the Royal Tomb

mobs.name: Rotten Skeleton Warrior of the Royal Tomb (Lance)

steps.text: Find 5x "Royal Tomb Keeper’s Book" from Minister of the Royal Tomb
Find 5x "Royal Tomb Keeper’s Lute" from Maid of Honor of the Royal Tomb

mobs.name: Maid of Honor of the Royal Tomb

steps.text: Find 5x "Royal Tomb Keeper’s Sword" from The Royal Tomb Keeper

stages.title: Stage 30 — Lv 58: Tomb Keeper continues
stages.where: Pub of the Giant Bird.

steps.text: Find 5x "Royal Tomb Keeper’s Shield" from The Royal Tomb Keeper

stages.title: Stage 31 — Lv 59-60: Tomb Keeper finale (last quests on this server)
stages.where: Pub of the Giant Bird.
stages.combo: Quest 62 is the last quest on this server — nothing beyond Lv 60 exists yet.

steps.text: Find 5x "Royal Tomb Keeper’s Spear" from The Royal Tomb Keeper
Find 5x "Royal Tomb Keeper’s Iron Hammer" from The Royal Tomb Keeper
